name: Subaru/HSC
full_name: Subaru Hyper Suprime-Cam dark matter programmes
summary: Wide-field camera on Japan's Subaru telescope, used for weak-lensing dark-matter mapping and high-cadence M31 microlensing searches. The facility is in Hawaii and must not be placed in Japan based on collaboration nationality.
detection_principle: Wide-field precision imaging measures background-galaxy distortions, or high-cadence M31 stellar observations search for short magnifications to constrain primordial black holes.

status.label: Operation supported by evidence
status.evidence: The official 2019 study and observing instrument have been checked; the latest operational cycle requires separate verification.

key_parameters.name: Representative high-cadence M31 exposure
key_parameters.value: 7 hours; a single-night search, not the entire HSC survey

results.summary: Microlensing upper limits constrain part of the sublunar-mass primordial-black-hole parameter space.
Subsequent work shows that assumptions such as finite source size strongly affect limits in some mass ranges.

science_scope: Constrains dark-matter distribution and properties through gravity, microlensing or structure statistics; does not directly identify dark-matter particles.
